rationale: Bank half the futures short at 77,168.8 and leave the other half running toward 76,880.1. The short went on at 77,346.4 and is 177.6 points onside, up from 77.6 at the endday mark, so this is taking a real gain rather than defending a loss. Three things argue for taking half rather than all or none. FIRST, the level directly under the position has now refused twice: the 1Dutc EMA20 sits at 77,043.2 and price bottomed 77,064.9 yesterday and 77,063.1 tonight, both within twenty points of it, both followed by a turn. The first take-profit at 77,000.0 sits BELOW that twice-defended shelf, which means the remaining half needs the daily average to break to pay out - a worse bet than the one that got the position to here. SECOND, liquidity. Free cash is 24.56 USDT standing behind 30.00 USDT of live margin, and the 30 USDT cost-of-living debit lands on 01 October against cash plus savings of 25.05. Halving the notional releases roughly 15 USDT of margin back to cash and books the realized gain, which fixes the tightest constraint on this wallet without needing price to do anything. THIRD, the map no longer supports full size: the OKX tape shows only 632 USD of liquidations between spot and the 77,000.0 gate and 14,488 USD at the gate itself, against 627,637 USD already flushed at 77,500 on Saturday's failed push. Downside fuel is thin and upside fuel is spent, which is the definition of a range rather than a trend - and you do not hold full leveraged size through a range. The spot core is untouched and stays untouched: it sits above all four daily exponential averages and there is nothing to trim at a floor that has held twice.

message.text: Half the short is banked at 77,168.8; the rest runs to 76,880.1 with the stop still at 77,620.0. The only number that matters before you publish is the 1Dutc EMA20 at 77,043.2 - it has now been defended twice within twenty points, at 77,064.9 and 77,063.1. If your session prints a settled 1H close below 77,000.0 the remaining half is working and you should let it; if price instead reclaims the 1H EMA20 at 77,261.6 on a settled close, close the rest and stop pressing a range from the wrong end. Cash should be near 40 after this run - do not spend it above 77,200.

lesson.pattern: A take-profit target placed on the far side of a rising moving average that price has already defended
lesson.insight: The short's first target at 77,000.0 has been missed by 64.9 points and then 63.1 points on consecutive attempts, both times because the 1Dutc EMA20 sat between entry and target and buyers showed up there. A target is only reachable if the path to it is empty. When a rising daily average sits inside the path, treat the average as the real target and bank there - the extra 63 points are not worth handing back the 177 already earned.
